changelog:
- Initial release of extensive REST API reference documentation covering 147 services.
- Includes authentication patterns, endpoints, rate limits, and common pitfalls for each service.
- Provides organized API categories, quick-reference tables, and curl code examples.
- Features clear navigation instructions for finding API info efficiently.
- Documentation only—no code execution; users handle their own credentials and commands.
summary: Comprehensive REST API reference covering 147 services with detailed authentication patterns, endpoints, rate limits, and common pitfalls. Enables seamless integration and robust data exchange across multiple platforms. Reliable, up-to-date, and extensively tested to accelerate development and reduc
